module: Auxiliary single-use pyrotechnic charge controller: as soon as one of the electrics listed in triggerElectrics equals 1 or true, it plays a sound, breaks breakgroups and detaches couplers, then displays a message. Used for explosive separations (bolts, stages, trailers). Can also be triggered manually by trigger().
notes: jbeam keys read: triggerElectrics (list of electric names), breakgroups (list of breakgroup names), couplers (list of coupler names), eventName ("event:>Vehicle>Failures>pyrotechnic_charge"), eventVolume (1), uiName ("", used in the message), eventNode (node name; first node with that name, otherwise 0).
A trigger through updateGFX happens only once (hasTriggered) until reset; the direct call to trigger() is not protected and does not set hasTriggered to true.
Couplers are detached with beamstate.detachCouplers(name, true, true).

init.desc: Reads the jbeam configuration and finds the sound node.

updateGFX.desc: Every frame: if a trigger electric is active and the charge has not already been fired, calls trigger().

trigger.desc: Fires the charge: plays the sound on the node, breaks the breakgroups, detaches the couplers and displays a 5 s message.
